description: Say which issue of the project's own Jira this issue is: its key (ACME-123) or its link on the site. The key is asked of that Jira first — one it does not have, or the token cannot see, is refused. An empty 'jiraKey' removes the link. One Jira issue per issue; the change is a line in the issue's history. Needs a Jira connected to the project and permission to edit the issue.

jiraKey.description: The Jira issue: 'ACME-123' or 'https://acme.atlassian.net/browse/ACME-123'. Empty removes the link.

name: set_jira_link
